int_name: RISING SUN AVE & E ROOSEVELT BLVD

result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane intersection in a commercial/mixed-use area with significant deficiencies in pedestrian infrastructure. There are no visible marked crosswalks, pedestrian signals, or curb ramps at the immediate intersection, forcing pedestrians to cross a wide expanse of asphalt unprotected.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide, unmarked intersection requires pedestrians to cross a large area of vehicle travel lanes without any refuge or markings.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground and midground across the roadway

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Control/Markings
hazards.description: No crosswalks or signals are visible to manage vehicle-pedestrian interactions at this wide junction.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the corner of the commercial building may block sight lines between drivers and pedestrians entering the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of image in front of the Allstate building

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to define pedestrian paths and alert drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a median refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane arterial road with a high volume of vehicle traffic and a marked crosswalk that lacks signalization. While a sidewalk and a small concrete refuge area are present, the environment is dominated by high-speed vehicle infrastructure and significant crossing distances.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic with only a narrow, unprotected median for refuge.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Crossing
hazards.description: The marked crosswalk lacks a traffic signal or pedestrian-activated beacon despite the high volume of traffic.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Traffic
hazards.description: The high volume of queued and moving vehicles can obscure pedestrians from drivers in adjacent lanes (multiple threat).

interventions.title: Pedestrian Hybrid Beacon (PHB)
interventions.description: Install a signalized crossing to provide a protected interval for pedestrians to cross this high-volume arterial.

interventions.title: Raised Median Refuge Island
interventions.description: Expand and improve the existing median into a wider, protected refuge island with bollards or curbing.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane intersection with a marked continental crosswalk, but lacks significant pedestrian protection. While a crosswalk is present, the long crossing distance and lack of a refuge island or visible pedestrian signals increase exposure to vehicle traffic.
